standard_prerequisites.name: Injective and bijective pigeonhole completeness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author Lemma5 states folklore completeness and retains the authors original proof sketch; it is a cited standard premise, not a new selected claim.

core_obligations: Preserve full formal Grid syntax and all solution types.
Retain full path-pigeonhole reduction and the complete formal SOPL/EOPL circuit constructions, including all case analyses and author diagrams.
Keep the dependent two main collapses grouped; do not count folklore or CLS consequences separately.
difficulty_reason: The authors use path-pigeonhole gadgets to conceal many-to-one merging while permitting efficient predecessor computation. Replicated nodes and carefully routed edges transform the PLS/PPADS meet into sink potential lines; a second construction embeds bijective pigeonhole structure and reverses lines to obtain the PPAD collapse.
